messages.author: 4a15de51da4445ae
messages.subject: unmarked version 1.0 is released
parts:
Dear unmarked users,

This was an eventful week for unmarked. After about 13 years, we have
finally released version 1.0 which is now available on CRAN.  Ken Kellner 
is largely responsible for this great achievement. Over the last few months 
he has added enormous capacity to unmarked including what were the
keystone capabilities which we feel make unmarked "complete".

Our goal with unmarked has always been to provide a suite of model for
basic sampling methods (presence/absence, binomial counts, multinomial
counts, distance sampling) which applied to basic closed systems and
also open models that accommodate demographic structure consistent
with the Dail-Madsen model for point counts.

We've had dynamic occupancy models since the beginning, Richard
Chandler and Jeff Hostettler added the Dail-Madsen model
("pcountOpen") many years ago, and then just recently Ken Kellner
added new functions 'distsampOpen' and 'multmixOpen' for distance
sampling models and multinomial mixture models. With these additions,
the "vision" is complete and now we have version 1.0 of the
package. One thing that's really unique about unmarked is that these
classes of models are naturally appealing in ecological applications
and yet most of them don't exist in any other software package.

In addition to the new functions 'distsampOpen' and 'multmixOpen', Ken
has recently added whole new classes of models for multi-state
occupancy models (including both single-season and dynamic models)
with the 'occuMS' function and he added "time-to-detection" occupancy
models with the 'occuTTD' function which also fits both single season
and dynamic models (thanks to Jonathan Cohen at SUNY ESF also). Last
year the 'occuMulti' function for fitting multi-species occupancy
models was added.

Other features from the previous 0.13 version which I think are
important include:
  o New 'crossVal' function for doing cross-validation on fitted unmarked models and fitLists
  o New 'vif' function for calculating variance inflation factors for fitted unmarked models
  o Add ability to use complimentary-log-log link function in occu
  o Add built-in dependent double observer pi function

Again, thanks to Ken Kellner for pushing all of this forward.

Incidentally, we also have nearly 1100 registered users on the email list.

Thanks to all the unmarked users who support the effort by responding
to queries on this email list too!

regards
andy
